page_segmentation.description: Invoice detailing goods purchased with a total amount.

data.rationale: The document is classified as an INVOICE because it contains a detailed list of goods and services purchased, along with a total amount due. The first page includes an invoice number and vendor information, indicating it is a commercial invoice. The second page provides payment instructions, which supports the classification as a payable document. There are no indications of it being a credit memo, customs document, or any other non-payable type.
